Name: grep_search
Description: Find exact pattern matches within workspace files or directories. Returns bounded, numbered context grouped by file. Use Includes to limit file patterns. Ignores protected paths. IsRegex defaults false; regex matching has a short timeout.

Name: codebase_search
Description: Find relevant functions or symbol chunks in the permitted workspace. Ranks with BM25; embeddings participate only when the user explicitly enables hybrid search and its separate USD budget. Returns whole bounded chunks and ranking provenance.
